candidate_sentences.text: Churn fell to 1% from 2%, and there was no churn in the DACH region.
Net revenue retention was 106%, down from 108%, while net uplift declined to 7% from 10%.

Average revenue per account increased 8% to DKK 228,000, while customer acquisition cost rose to DKK 371,000 from DKK 222,000 and CAC payback increased to 22 months from 15 months because of higher lead-generation spending and fewer new customers.

verified_key_information_units.information: Impero surpassed 200 customers by end-2025, with customer base diversification (40% of Danish C25 index and 22.5% of German DAX index) and reduced top-10 customer concentration to 20% of ARR.
verified_key_information_units.source_evidence: Management commentary: 'By the end of 2025, we reached a significant milestone as our customer base surpassed 200 customers... total customer coverage is 40% of the C25 index and 22.5% of the DAX index... top 10 customer concentration measured on ARR has decreased from 37% to 20% as of year-end 2025'.

candidate_sentences.text: The customer base exceeded 200 after 26 new customer wins, while top-10 customer concentration fell to 20% from 24%, strengthening revenue diversification.

verified_key_information_units.information: Growth was driven primarily by Denmark (22% YoY net new ARR growth) and DACH region (26% YoY growth, 44% of total ARR), with strategic expansion planned for UK, Nordics, and Benelux markets.
verified_key_information_units.source_evidence: ARR development and SaaS metrics: 'In Denmark... 22% YoY... DACH region... 26% growth YoY... ARR from other markets declined to DKK 5.5M... strategic focus to expand... UK as well as Benelux'. Management commentary details regional performance and expansion plans.

candidate_sentences.text: Growth was led by Denmark and DACH, where net new ARR grew 22% and 26%, respectively.

verified_key_information_units.information: Key product milestones included launch of Control Testing module, AI-augmented engineering adoption, and initiation of Entity Management development planned for 2026.
verified_key_information_units.source_evidence: Management commentary: 'True to previous commitments, we have delivered on launching the Control Testing module in July 2025... advancing our AI agenda... Entity Management – supporting segmentation across global enterprises... delivery planned for 2026'. Product milestones section details features and AI integration.

candidate_sentences.text: Product development included the July launch of the Control Testing module, initial AI features, and preparations for Entity Management, supporting enterprise expansion and upselling opportunities.

verified_key_information_units.information: Impero raised DKK 15M via directed issue in December 2025, ending 2025 with DKK 18.9M cash; the Board deferred the ambition for recurring cash flow positivity before end-2026 to fund growth investments.
verified_key_information_units.source_evidence: Equity and capital: 'raised DKK 15M in a private placement in December 2025... equity stood at DKK 15.4M... cash position of DKK 18.9M'. Strategy update: 'Board of Directors believes that growth investments will create more long-term value than pursuing cash flow positivity before end of 2026... deferred its ambition... as announced in Company Announcement No. 3-2026'.

candidate_sentences.text: Cash ended at DKK 18.9 million after a DKK 15 million directed issue in December, with equity rising to DKK 15.4 million.
Given the stronger capital position, Impero deferred its ambition of recurring positive cash flow before the end of 2026 to prioritize commercial investments.

verified_key_information_units.information: The Board accelerated commercial investments for 2026 (including new hires) to increase ARR growth, expecting ARR of DKK 53-57M (+15-23% YoY) but EBITDA of DKK -2M to -1M due to higher costs.
verified_key_information_units.source_evidence: Guidance for 2026: 'Impero expects ARR to reach between DKK 53M and 57M... ARR growth rate of approx. 15% to 23%... EBITDA expected to be in the range of DKK -2M to -1M... new planned hires across commercial organization will increase cost base'. Strategy update details investment plans.

candidate_sentences.text: For 2026, it guides for ARR of DKK 53–57 million and EBITDA between negative DKK 2 million and positive DKK 1 million.
Given the stronger capital position, Impero deferred its ambition of recurring positive cash flow before the end of 2026 to prioritize commercial investments.

verified_key_information_units.information: Expansion of partner network in DACH region to five revenue-generating partners complemented own channel, which generated 71% of new ARR in 2025.
verified_key_information_units.source_evidence: Management commentary: 'expanded our partner network in Germany... five revenue generating partners in the DACH region... working with several certified consultancies across the German speaking markets, including the four leading global auditing networks (Big4)... own channel led new ARR generation in 2025... new ARR from own channels constituted 71% of total new ARR... partners experienced delay in decision making from their customers, which dampened our partner sales in 2025'. Channel Split section confirms partner vs own channel contribution.

details.completeness_justification: All HIGH importance criteria (K1-K7) are fully represented in the candidate summary with supporting trace sentences. K8 (MEDIUM importance) regarding partner network expansion in DACH is missing entirely. The summary captures ARR growth, EBITDA improvement, churn/NRR metrics, customer base expansion, growth drivers by region, product milestones, capital structure changes, and 2026 guidance - representing all core material elements required for a complete picture. The absence of only one MEDIUM criterion does not change the overall understanding of the financial report.

coherence_issues.description: While profitability improvement is stated (S5), the specific metrics (EBITDA, operating loss) and cost explanations (S6-S8) do not explicitly connect the operational drivers to the stated profitability improvement. The link between cost changes and profitability outcomes could be articulated more clearly.

candidate_sentences.text: Profitability improved substantially.
EBITDA was negative DKK 3.1 million, compared with negative DKK 8.7 million in 2024, while operating loss improved to DKK 6.7 million from DKK 11.7 million.
Management attributed the improvement primarily to 19% revenue growth combined with lower increases in staff costs and other external expenses, which rose 6% each.
Cost of sales decreased 16%, increasing the contribution margin to 98% from 97%.

coherence_issues.description: S11 states that 'some efficiency indicators weakened' but does not specify which indicators or the nature of the weakening. S13 then lists specific efficiency metrics (net revenue retention, net uplift) that declined. The connection between the general statement in S11 and the specific metrics in S13 is implicit but not explicitly drawn, creating a minor logical gap.

candidate_sentences.text: SaaS metrics remained strong, although some efficiency indicators weakened.
Net revenue retention was 106%, down from 108%, while net uplift declined to 7% from 10%.

details.coherence_justification: The summary is generally coherent with a clear narrative structure covering growth, profitability, metrics, and guidance. There are no self-contradictions or major organizational issues. Minor logical gaps exist in the explanation of profitability drivers and the linkage between a general efficiency weakening statement and specific metric declines, but these do not materially undermine the overall coherence. Repetition is minimal and does not affect clarity.
